full_judgment: 3. Brief faces are that the respondent here-in as petitioner preferred Writ Petition No.3572 of 2018 impugning memo under নথি নং-৪/এলটিইডি, মূসক/৩০৮/লিগ্যাল অ্যাফেয়ার্স/ঢাকা টোব্যাকো/রিট/১০/১৮০৯ তারিখ ২১.১১.২০১৮ passed by the Commissioner, Large Taxpayers Unit (LTU) VAT, Dhaka demanding VAT under section 55(3) of the VAT Act and also issuing in the same memo final notice under section 9(2) of the VAT Act cancelling the rebate taken by the petitioner in violation of the provisions of the Value Added Tax Act, 1991 (hereinafter referred as 'VAT Act') contending interalia that the petitioner is an industry of SK. Akijuddin Limited and engaged in manufacturing different brands .of lower-segment and mid-segment cigarettes; On 07.10.2007 the petitioner received a show cause notice for evasion of VAT. amounting Tk.96,94,03,342.44 for the period 2002-2006; The petitioner replied the notice on 31.12.2007 refuting the allegation and submitted all necessary documents with a prayer for withdrawal of the show cause notice; After getting the reply, respondent no.2 formed an investigation team to justify the contention of the petitioner; The investigation team after collecting information submitted its report stating that the claim of Tk. 92,36,74,298/- has no basis and recommended to issue an amended show cause notice by deducting the amount of Tk. 92,36,74,298/-; Inspite of the report, the respondent no. 3 without issuing any amended or new show cause notice under section 55(1) of the VAT Act informed the petitioner by a letter dated 15.12.2009 that the date of hearing has been fixed on 23.12.2009 for disposal of the matter; The 'petitioner replied to the notice on 23.12.2009 reiterating its contention and prayed to withdraw the demand which is barred by limitation under section 55(1) of the VAT Act; But ignoring the petitioner's reply or issuing any show cause notice under section 55(1) of the VAT Act, the respondent no.2 on 18.01.2010 passed a demand order under section 55(3) of the VAT Act directing the petitioner to deposit an amount of Tk.4,57,29,044.44 for evasion of VAT.
